principle: Each TOOL CATEGORY is an agnostic PLANE: an open registry that can hold HUNDREDS of pluggable tools behind ONE port, so the supervisor (the descent/planner) selects the cheapest tool that meets the bar when composing a capability. A new tool drops in by a registry row (or an adapter) with zero caller change — exactly the OCR case (hundreds of OCR engines, one ocr_port). Planes are populated from internal catalogs + the discovery flywheels (mining repos/products/startups that use LLMs). A capability leaf (architecture/capability_taxonomy.json) names the planes it draws on. serves_truth=false.

status_legend.wired: has a port behind which tools plug in
status_legend.partial: a port-ish exists; formalize as a clean plane
status_legend.gap: no port yet — wrap next (the adapters flywheel files it)

planes.name: Vision / grounding models
planes.registry: (in web_browsing_stack_registry driving_components; formalize a vision plane)

planes.name: Rules engines / decision logic
planes.registry: Durable Rules / business-rules / decision-trees / FSMs (the deterministic-logic replacement for repeated policy reasoning)

planes.name: Deterministic workflow orchestration
planes.registry: Temporal / Prefect / Airflow / Dagster / static DAG (replaces LLM re-planning of fixed API sequences)

planes.name: Structured data extraction / dataframes
planes.registry: Pandas / Polars / DuckDB / Camelot / Tabula / PyMuPDF / pdfplumber / Tika

planes.name: Deterministic typed-field parsers
planes.registry: dates/phones/addresses/emails/quantities/names — dateparser / phonenumbers / libpostal / usaddress / quantulum3 / Duckling (replaces an LLM 'reading' a phone number or date)

planes.name: Fuzzy string / phonetic / record linkage
planes.registry: RapidFuzz / jellyfish / dedupe / splink / recordlinkage / textdistance (deterministic match + dedupe instead of LLM 'are these the same?')

planes.name: Classical ML classifiers/regressors + language ID
planes.registry: scikit-learn / fastText / XGBoost / LightGBM / SetFit / lingua / langdetect (a trained deterministic classifier replaces a frontier model for routing)

planes.name: Constraint / SMT / LP / routing solvers
planes.registry: OR-Tools / Z3 / PuLP / CVXPY / python-constraint / NetworkX (replaces LLM planning/scheduling/allocation with a provably-correct solver)

planes.name: AST / grammar / structural parse + rewrite
planes.registry: tree-sitter / Lark / pyparsing / ANTLR / ast-grep / Comby (deterministic parse + structural rewrite instead of LLM code/format editing)

planes.name: Deterministic codegen / templates
planes.registry: Jinja2 / datamodel-code-generator / quicktype / OpenAPI Generator / Cookiecutter (generate boilerplate from schema, never re-prompt)

planes.name: Deterministic structural comparison
planes.registry: deepdiff / datacompy / jsonpatch / jsondiff / dictdiffer (find what changed/conflicts without an LLM)

planes.name: Memoization / semantic cache
planes.registry: diskcache / GPTCache / joblib / cachetools (implements the caching pass — return a prior verified result instead of recomputing)
